title: Zonal Sales Head
location: Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, India
jobDescription: Brief Job Description: Sales and Revenue Management: Lead and manage all sales activities within the zone,ensuring that billing targets are met or exceeded. Regularly review sales reports, leadsgenerated, conversions, and discuss outcomes with the team to refine strategies. Marketing Strategy Development: Formulate and implement marketing strategies tailored tomarket conditions, demographics, and other relevant factors, driving brand awareness andlead generation within the zone Placement Success: Collaborate with academic and placement teams to ensure a high countof eligible student placements, thereby enhancing the brands reputation and success rate. Technical Know-How Income Recovery: Ensure the full recovery of technical know-howincome from all BPs (Business Partners), maintaining a robust income stream for the brand. Financial Dropouts and Rollover Recovery: Implement strategies to reduce financialdropouts and achieve success rate in rollover recovery, ensuring financial stability andstudent retention across the zone. Process Monitoring and Compliance: Monitor BPs, team members, and indirect reporteesfor adherence to processes, target achievement, leakages, logistics, collections, and checklistcompliance. Implement corrective actions to maintain operational efficiency. Compliance and Audit Management: Ensure complete compliance with financial audits,with no instances of unreported income. This includes monitoring process adherence,financial reporting accuracy, and addressing any discrepancies proactively. Team Development and Knowledge Building: Continuously build and upgrade knowledge forboth self and the team on products, policies, and processes. Accompany team members inthe field, assist in client meetings, and support closures as necessary. Goal Setting and Action Planning: Set clear, realistic, and challenging goals for the team.Develop detailed action plans to achieve these goals, ensuring alignment with the brand'soverall business development strategy. Budget Management: Develop budget projections based on market trends, expansion plans,and business development strategies. Monitor actual spending against budgeted figures andensure strict compliance with financial plans. Annual Business Development Planning: Create and execute an annual businessdevelopment plan, breaking it down into actionable sections based on goals, timelines,budgets, and available resources. Assign realistic and relevant targets for the team to achievethroughout the year. Desired Candidate Profile: Strategic Sales Leadership Financial Acumen Marketing Strategy Team Development and Leadership Compliance and Process Management Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills Client Relationship Management Qualifications & Experience Qualification: Graduate/ Management Graduate Work Experience: 12 plus years of experience in Sales

title: GenAI Engineer
jobDescription:
Brief Job Description: Generative AI Solution Development: Develop and implement advanced solutions using Generative AI technologies, leveraging frameworks such as Python, Lang Chain, and Hugging Face. Engage in prompt engineering, working with Large Language Models (LLMs) to create tailored AI-driven solutions. Ensure response accuracy of prompts. Make sure the prompts generate desired outcomes and adhere to instructions. Model Fine-Tuning and Optimization: Fine-tune pre-trained models from Hugging Face and other platforms to meet project-specific requirements. Optimize AI models for efficiency, accuracy, and scalability in educational contexts. Achieve minimum accuracy thresholds for models. Reduce model training time and computational resource usage. Innovate AI techniques or algorithms at least once per quarter. Collaboration with Business Teams: Collaborate with business stakeholders to align AI solutions with organizational goals, translating business requirements into technical specifications. Participate in cross-functional collaboration meetings, ensuring effective communication of AI model capabilities. AI Frameworks and Tooling: Utilize frameworks like Lang Chain, Cohere, Keras, Tensor Flow, and Py Torch for developing, testing, and deploying AI models. Integrate AI solutions into existing systems for seamless user experiences. Ensure AI deployment times are within defined timelines (e.g., from training to production). Maintain model latency below a defined threshold for real-time inference (e.g., under decided milliseconds). Research and Innovation: Stay updated on the latest advancements in Generative AI, machine learning, and deep learning technologies. Experiment with new methodologies and emerging AI technologies to innovate and enhance existing solutions. Introduce innovative AI algorithms or approaches at least once per quarter. System Architecture and Integration: Design robust system architectures using frameworks like Fast API and Unicorn to support AI-driven applications. Ensure AI solutions are scalable, maintainable, and integrated effectively with other system components. Ensure efficient use of computing resources and optimize costs while maintaining performance standards. Performance Monitoring and Improvement: Monitor AI model performance, applying ML engineering metrics to continuously improve outcomes. Troubleshoot issues related to model performance and integration, resolving critical bugs quickly. Reductions in code execution time and model bugs. Ensure AI-related code has unit testing coverage for robustness. Documentation: Provide comprehensive documentation for all developed models, data pipelines, and processes, explaining functionality and edge cases. Maintain detailed documentation of new features and code implementations. Ensure step-by-step deployment and retraining documentation, with minimal user-reported gaps or confusion. Desired Candidate Profile:

EDUCATION:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, AI, or related fields. Experience: 3-5 years of experience, with at least 1 year specializing in AI/ML. Required Skill Set: Prompt Engineering Python Programming AI and ML Frameworks Deep Learning Architectures Mathematical and Statistical Knowledge System Architecture Design Model Fine-Tuning Collaboration and Communication Continuous Learning

title: Alliance Manager
jobDescription: Brief Job Description: Alliance Coordination : Manage all responsibilities related to the alliance, serving as the single point of contact (SPOC) between the university, centers, and Aptech to ensure seamless communication and collaboration. Documentation Management : Handle all documentation related to student admissions, ensuring that all student registration documents, and ID cards are processed according to university requirements. Ensure that all course-related documentation is completed within the specified timeframe for all courses. Student Information Sharing : Ensure that accurate and up-to-date information is consistently shared with students, keeping them informed about important processes and timelines like Certificates & results sharing. Examination Coordination : Oversee the scheduling and conduct of examinations for all eligible students, ensuring they are carried out according to the established schedule. Financial & Administrative Reporting : Maintain comprehensive financial and administrative reports, ensuring timely submission of reports to the finance department. Compliance & Audit Resolution : Address and resolve audit queries (including those related to management systems, finances, and processes) within the stipulated timeframe, ensuring full compliance with internal and external audit requirements. Faculty Training (FT) Coordination : Ensure that all faculty training is completed as per norms and within the required quarterly timelines. Desired Candidate Profile: Qualification: Any Graduate Work Experience: 2-3 years of experience in student coordination Key Skills: Data reconciliation and record-keeping abilities. Time management and organizational skills for handling visits and admission activities. Proficient in MS Excel. Ability to handle follow-ups and resolve pending student-related financial matters.

title: Tele Sales Manager
jobDescription: Brief Job Description: Conduct outbound calls to prospective franchisee leads. Qualify prospects based on business profile, investment capacity, and suitability. Present the franchise opportunity and address prospect queries and objections. Drive end-to-end sales conversations and close opportunities independently wherever possible. Schedule and coordinate meetings for qualified prospects with the sales team when required. Maintain regular follow-ups and nurture prospects through the sales funnel. Update CRM records and track lead progress accurately. Achieve monthly targets for lead qualification, meetings, and franchisee conversions. Desired Candidate Profile: 2–5 years of experience in telesales, inside sales, B2B sales, franchise sales, or business development. Strong communication, persuasion, negotiation, and closing skills. Ability to independently manage sales conversations and achieve targets. Experience working with CRM tools and sales pipelines. Self-motivated, disciplined, and result-oriented.

jobDescription:

title: Business Development Manager (International Franchisee Business)
jobDescription: Brief Job Description: Franchise/ Center Relationship Management : Develop and maintain strong relationships with franchise partners and center managers. Provide ongoing support, guidance, and training to franchisees to help them achieve their sales, marketing, and operational objectives. Act as a key point of contact for franchise partners, ensuring smooth communication and effective problem resolution. Business Development & Sales : Drive business growth by implementing strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets. Identify new business opportunities and support the expansion of the franchise network. Track and evaluate sales performance, identifying gaps and implementing corrective actions where necessary. Reporting & Performance Monitoring : Prepare and present sales performance reports, pipeline updates, and forecasts to the Business Head. Monitor key performance indicators and provide insights to support strategic decision making. Marketing Strategy & Execution : Develop and execute marketing plans aligned with sales goals to support franchise expansion and center performance. Plan and implement marketing campaigns to improve brand visibility and customer engagement. Digital Marketing : Plan and oversee digital marketing initiatives including SEO, SEM, social media marketing, email marketing, and content marketing. Monitor campaign performance and optimize strategies using data-driven insights. Promotional Activities : Organize and manage promotional events such as seminars, webinars, workshops, and franchise outreach programs to generate leads and increase brand awareness. Coordinate with creative teams for the development of marketing materials including brochures, banners, presentations, and videos. Market Research & Analysis : Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and customer feedback studies to identify market trends and growth opportunities. Stay updated with industry developments to ensure marketing and sales strategies remain competitive and relevant. title: Nutrition Faculty & Content Creator
jobDescription: Brief Job Description: Academic & Training Responsibilities Deliver classroom and practical training sessions in Nutrition, Dietetics, Wellness, and Healthy Lifestyle Management. Conduct interactive lectures, workshops, demonstrations, and student assessments. Prepare lesson plans, presentations, assignments, and evaluation materials. Guide students on nutrition practices, meal planning, weight management, and wellness concepts. Ensure high levels of student engagement, learning outcomes, and academic quality. Support students with doubt-solving, mentoring, and career guidance. Content Creation Responsibilities Develop academic content including study material, course modules, SOPs, handouts, and assessments. Create digital learning content for social media, webinars, workshops, blogs, and online courses. Research latest nutrition trends, wellness practices, and industry updates for content development. Write student-friendly and industry-relevant content aligned with curriculum objectives. Collaborate with marketing and academic teams for promotional and educational content creation. Assist in scripting educational videos, reels, presentations, and masterclasses. Operational Responsibilities Maintain academic records, attendance, assessments, and student progress reports. Participate in faculty training, academic audits, and curriculum enhancement initiatives. Ensure classroom discipline and adherence to academic standards. Support seminars, events, workshops, and student activities. title: Virtual Production Faculty (3D, Unreal Engine)
jobDescription: Brief Job Description: Deliver classroom, lab, and project-based training in virtual production concepts, tools, and workflows. Teach Unreal Engine modules including scene building, procedural content generation (PCG), materials, Blueprints, lighting, and Sequencer. Guide students in 3D content workflows using Maya and/or Blender. Introduce learners to photogrammetry workflows using Reality Capture or similar tools. Train students in camera tracking systems such as HTC Vive Mars, Stype, or equivalent platforms. Support motion capture learning using Rokoko or similar solutions. Demonstrate real-world film camera handling and connect on-set practices to virtual production environments. Simplify complex technical processes into practical, step-by-step learning experiences for students. Mentor learners on creative problem-solving, technical experimentation, and portfolio development aligned with industry expectations Stay updated with new tools, hardware, and production trends in order to keep training current and relevant. Desired Candidate Profile: Strong working knowledge of Unreal Engine, especially scene building, PCG, materials, Blueprints, lighting, and Sequencer. Proficiency in 3D workflow tools such as Maya and/or Blender. Hands-on familiarity with photogrammetry software such as Reality Capture or comparable platforms. Understanding of camera tracking systems, including HTC Vive Mars, Stype, or similar tools. Exposure to motion capture tools such as Rokoko or equivalent systems. Working knowledge of film camera operation and related production practices.
